About Us

30+ Years of Excellence in Window Coverings

Modern Home Blinds is a Canadian, family-owned company built on a simple promise: beautiful, custom window coverings — measured, manufactured, and installed by people who genuinely care about getting it right.

Everything we make is crafted locally at our Oakville, Ontario facility — never imported, never outsourced. That’s how we deliver premium quality and install most projects in under a week, while big-box and online sellers make you wait 4–8 weeks and measure it yourself.

From your free in-home consultation to the final install, one local team handles every detail — backed by our 5-year blinds and 3-year motor warranty. It’s why over 10,000 Canadian families have trusted us with their homes.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything You Need to Know

Zebra blinds are our most popular choice for living rooms in the GTA. They give you the best of both worlds — sheer panels that let in soft, diffused light during the day, and solid panels for full privacy at night. Roller shades are another great option for a cleaner, more minimal look. During your free in-home consultation, we’ll show you samples in your actual light conditions so you can see exactly how each option looks.

Custom blind pricing in the GTA varies by product type and window count. As a general guide: zebra blinds start from $180–$280 per window, roller shades from $150–$250, and California shutters from $300–$500. All prices include our free in-home measurement and professional installation. Use our free estimate tool above to get a personalized quote for your specific windows in under 60 seconds.

Motorized blinds are absolutely worth it, especially for hard-to-reach windows, large format windows, or if you want smart home integration. As a certified motorization partner, we install whisper-quiet motors that work with Google Home, Amazon Alexa, and Apple HomeKit. You can schedule your blinds to open at sunrise and close at sunset automatically. The motor upgrade typically adds $200–$350 per window to the cost of any blind type.

Yes. All of our custom blinds and shades are backed by a 5-year warranty, and our motorized components carry a 3-year warranty. Because we manufacture locally in Oakville, any warranty issue is handled quickly by our own team — no overseas shipping or long waits. We stand behind every product we install.

Unlike most competitors who take 4–8 weeks, we manufacture locally in Oakville which means we can typically complete the entire process — from in-home consultation to final installation — in under one week. This is one of our biggest differentiators. We don’t import from overseas and we don’t have long supply chains. Your blinds are made right here in Ontario.

Zebra blinds (also called day & night blinds) feature alternating sheer and solid horizontal fabric bands. By aligning or staggering the bands, you can go from full light to complete privacy. Roller shades are a single fabric panel that rolls up into a slim cassette — available in light-filtering, blackout, and solar screen. Zebra blinds are more visually dynamic; roller shades are cleaner and more architectural. Both come in dozens of fabric colours and opacities to suit any room.

Yes — we manufacture and install California shutters throughout Oakville, Mississauga, Toronto, Brampton, Burlington, Milton, and all surrounding GTA areas. California shutters are built with adjustable louvres and are available in PVC (moisture-resistant, ideal for bathrooms and kitchens) and real wood. Our free in-home consultation includes a measurement visit where we assess your windows and recommend the best shutter style for each room.

Most of our blinds are very easy to maintain. Roller shades and zebra blinds can be spot-cleaned with a damp cloth. California shutters wipe down easily with a microfibre cloth. Draperies can typically be removed and dry cleaned. We provide maintenance guidance after every installation and our team is always available to answer questions. Motorized blinds require zero manual operation, which also means fewer mechanical parts to wear out.

Yes, always — free in-home consultation is included with every order at no charge. We come to your home, take precise measurements of every window, and bring a full selection of fabric samples so you can see and feel the options in your own light. There is no obligation to purchase. Most consultations take 30–60 minutes. Book yours using the form at the top of this page or call us directly at 647-673-1847.
